summary: The parsed iteration count encloses a call to local SpMV. Rank row counts and entry offsets define contiguous row/nonzero slices, and local CSR offsets are rebased. Emitted host code inlines the timed iteration, row, and nonzero loops with indexed loads, multiply/add, and row stores; the outer counter/backedge is visible around that work.

source_evidence.claim: spmvCpu walks every local row and its CSR delimiter interval, accumulates val[j]*vec[cols[j]], and stores each output; -i is parsed, rank row/entry boundaries drive scatter, and the timed loop invokes spmvCpu once per iteration.

compiled_evidence.claim: The actual timed run path records MPI_Wtime, then its outer counter loop encloses local row and nonzero traversal; each nonzero performs indexed column/vector/value loads and multiply/add, each row stores output, and the assembly increments/compares the iteration counter and branches back before the ending MPI_Wtime.
